text:
Noah: Quick design review for the new time-series panel. Key decisions: condensed legend behavior, axis unit label wording, smoothing control discoverability, outlier badge behavior, and contrast for thin polylines. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/new-timeseries/panel-v3

Priya: Accessibility first: thin 1px faint lines are borderline for low-vision users. Prefer bump to 1.5px or increase contrast token. Also, when numbers use compact notation (e.g., 2.1K) provide an aria-label with full text like "2,100 requests per minute".

Iris: Legend idea: show a condensed pill on the top-left that displays swatches only, with a numeric count. Clicking opens an inline flyout with full names and a small search. On very narrow panels we switch to an inline stacked legend below the chart. This keeps charts readable without hiding mapping.

Devon: For units, ops team prefers explicit wording for dashboards used by non-dev stakeholders. Proposal: axis subtitle line: "Requests per minute (req/min)" where the parenthetical is the short unit. Tooltip shows the long form. Also add a chart-level toggle: [Auto units] vs [Explicit units].

Priya: Keyboard & screen reader details:
- Make the pill a <button aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="legend-flyout" aria-label="Open legend, 4 series">.
- When flyout opens, move focus into <ul role="listbox"> and support Arrow keys and Space to toggle visibility.
- Add an aria-live region for axis unit changes and outlier state changes. Debounce announcements 300ms to avoid chatter.

Noah: Outlier handling: product wants trend visibility by default (exclude extremes). UX mock shows a small "+n" badge pinned top-right when points are clipped. Clicking expands y-axis to include them. Should the badge be visible only on hover or always when clipping occurs?

Iris: Show badge always when clipping >0 but use low visual weight. Tooltip: "{n} points outside visible range. Click to include in scale." Make it keyboard focusable.

Devon: Also add a setting: "Include outliers in scale by default" per dashboard. Default = off for overview dashboards.

Priya: Suggested microcopy examples:
- Legend collapsed: "Legend collapsed, 4 series. Press Enter to open."
- Outlier badge: "Three points excluded from chart scale. Press Enter to include them."
- Unit change announcement: "Axis unit changed to requests per minute."

Noah: Smoothing control: analytics show smoothing toggles are used rarely. Let's move smoothing into the chart overflow menu under "Line options" with a small help text: "Smooth lines to emphasize trends; may hide spikes." Default: off for throughput/latency charts.

Iris: Visual tweaks: add caret on the pill, increase hit target to 44px, and ensure flyout has a subtle drop shadow. In the flyout, include a small search when series >8.

Devon: Implementation notes:
- Reuse Popover component but add an option for inline fallback if popover would clip.
- Implement formatNumberAccessible util for aria-labels.
- Add theme token for high-contrast line strokes.

ops-bot: Maintenance reminder: Frontend sandbox downtime tonight 23:30-00:00 UTC; testing may be impacted.

Noah: Decision summary for sign-off:
1) Condensed legend pill (button) with flyout; inline stacked fallback for tiny panels.
2) Axis subtitle with long + short unit, tooltip for full wording, aria-live for changes.
3) Outliers: show low-weight "+n" badge when clipping >0; focusable button to expand axis; dashboard-level default toggle.
4) Smoothing: move to overflow menu, default off.
5) Raise thin-line minimum and add high-contrast token.

Can design + eng ack?
